{"consolidated_memory":"TRUNCATED DOCUMENTS IN SEARCH/INDEXER/CHUNKER.TS - FOUR SEPARATE INCIDENTS

**File:** search/indexer/chunker.ts (search side)
**Symptom (all 4 incidents):** Chunk offsets that stop short of the document length
**Repro (all 4 incidents):** Index the long changelog fixture

---

**INCIDENT 1: [2026-06-02] Cold Start - Connection Pool Exhaustion**
- Trigger: First request after cold start
- Root Cause: Connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Outcome: Job finished in 45 minutes instead of 3 hours (11.5x improvement)
- Fix: Raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it
- PR: #5169 on branch fix/truncated-documents-1

**INCIDENT 2: [2026-06-11] Fleet Rolling Restart - Datetime Comparison Bug**
- Trigger: After rolling restart of the fleet
- Root Cause: A naive datetime compared against an aware one (timezone mismatch)
- Outcome: Reclaimed 70 GB of blob storage
- Fix: Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- PR: #7375 on branch fix/truncated-documents-2

**INCIDENT 3: [2026-08-18] Request Race Condition - Config Loader Bug**
- Trigger: When two requests raced on the same key
- Root Cause: The config loader reading the wrong environment file
- Outcome: Backlog cleared 12 minutes after the deploy
- Fix: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
- PR: #8290 on branch fix/truncated-documents-3

**INCIDENT 4: [2026-08-20] Legacy SDK Clients - Swallowed Exception**
- Trigger: For clients still pinned to the v1 SDK
- Root Cause: An error swallowed by a bare except handler
- Outcome: p99 latency fell from 6.6 s to 29 ms
- Fix: Narrowed the exception handler and let the failure propagate
- PR: #9378 on branch fix/truncated-documents-4

All four incidents affected the same code area with the same symptom but distinct root causes and fixes."}
